Hoang 10-07-94 1.9 changed hints* Linh Tran 03-10-95 2.0 added online help** Abstract:* This form allows an operator to close a box and print the* pack slip.** Menu Reference:* Distribution Functions, Close Box** Error Conditions:* '0000' - transaction committed* '0200' - Invalid function key* '0306' - Invalid order number* '0600' - unsuccessful commit* '2301' - Enter 'Y' and 'N' and press [Nxtfld]* '2401' - Nothing to commit* '2701' - All units requested have been allocated* '2702' - Enter 'X' and Press [MENU] to allocate* '2703' - No Units have been allocated to this order* '2704' - Enough units have been allocated to this item* '2705' - Enter 'X' and Press [Menu] to allocate this unit* '2706' - No units available to allocate** Inputs:* Order Number** Outputs:* Pick Slip ID - Screen* Pick Slip Report - Printout** Modules Referenced:* handle_error - SRVLIB* check_package_failure - SRVLIB* post_transaction - SRVLIB* commit_transaction - SRVLIB** Assumptions and Limitations:* None.** Functional Descriptions:** 1. Operator enters a Box ID Number, either by scanning it in or* from a list of values (after entering 'M' for manual entry).** 2. Next the operator can look at individual items in the box or* press [COMMIT] to close the box. Pressing [EXIT] key will* also close the box after a box ID is entered.****************************************************************************

declare
 box_cnt number;
 v_local_time date;
begin
 nullchk;
 begin
 select max(ord.order_no)
 into :ctrl_blk_1.order_no
 from boxes bx, orders ord, pick_slip_products psp,
 pick_slips ps
 where bx.box_id = :ctrl_blk_1.box_id
 and bx.box_status = 'OP'
 and bx.box_id = psp.box_id
 and psp.pick_slip_id = ps.pick_slip_id
 and ps.order_no = ord.order_no
 and ord.order_status not in ('CL','CA','SY','HO','PE')
 and bx.chapter_id = :g_chapter_id
 /*MODIFIED BY HCL CONSULTING*/
 and ord.chapter_id = :GLOBAL.chapter_id
 and psp.chapter_id = :GLOBAL.chapter_id
 and ps.chapter_id = :GLOBAL.chapter_id
 and bx.warehouse_id = :GLOBAL.warehouse;
 /*MODIFIED BY HCL CONSULTING*/
 if :ctrl_blk_1.order_no is null
 then
 show_error_dist('0334'); -- invalid box
 check_package_failure;
 end if;
 end;
 begin
 select o.consignee_id, name, ADDRESS_1||' '|| ADDRESS_2 ||' '|| ADDRESS_3 ||' '|| CITY ||', '||STATE ||', '||COUNTRY||', '|| ZIP, ordered_by,phone_no,
 est_arrival_time
 into :consignee_id ,:ship_to,:address,:contact_name,:phone_no,
 :est_arrival_time
 from orders o, consignee c
 where c.consignee_id = o.consignee_id
 and o.order_no = :order_no
 and c.chapter_id = :g_chapter_id
 and o.chapter_id = :g_chapter_id
 and sysdate between c.eff_date
 and nvl(c.term_date,sysdate+1);
 
 -- time zone change --03/04/11--sandip
 if Is_TIMEZONE_ENABLED then
 Lifetrack_timezone_convert.get_local_time(:global.chapter_id,to_date(to_char(:est_arrival_time,'MM-DD-RR HH24:MI'),'MM-DD-RR HH24:MI'),v_local_time);
 :est_arrival_time := to_date(to_char(v_local_time,'MM-DD-RR HH24:MI'),'MM-DD-RR HH24:MI');
 end if; 
 
 exception
 when OTHERS
 then null;
-- tackle_error('Orders, Consignee');
-- check_package_failure;
 end;
 exception
 when OTHERS
 then
 handle_error;
 check_package_failure;
end;

Trigger.Name: KEY-NEXT-ITEM
Trigger.TriggerText:
declare
 res_pend_cnt number;
 box_capacity number;
 BoxType varchar2(2);
 MfgProductType varchar2(5);
 capacity number;
begin
 capacity := 0;
 box_capacity := 0;
 res_pend_cnt := 0;
 valid_yesno;
 if :s_close_box = 'Y'
 then
 begin
 select count(*) into res_pend_cnt
 from pick_slip_products
 where box_id = :ctrl_blk_1.box_id and
 product_status = 'RP' and
 chapter_id = :GLOBAL.chapter_id;
 /*MODIFIED BY HCL CONSULTING*/
 if res_pend_cnt > 0
 then
 show_error_dist('3310');
 check_package_failure;
 end if;
 end;
 begin
 select box_type, mfg_product_type
 into BoxType, MfgProductType
 from boxes
 where box_id = :ctrl_blk_1.box_id
 and chapter_id = :GLOBAL.chapter_id;
 /*MODIFIED BY HCL CONSULTING*/
 if MfgProductType is not null
 then
 begin
 select capacity into box_capacity
 from vserv_box_capacity
 where box_type = BoxType and
 product_type = MfgProductType and
 sysdate between eff_date and nvl(term_date, sysdate + 365);
 exception
 when NO_DATA_FOUND
 then null;
 when OTHERS
 then
 message ('Err while getting box capacity');
 handle_error;
 end;
 select count(*) into capacity
 from pick_slip_products
 where box_id = :ctrl_blk_1.box_id and
 product_status = 'PK' and
 chapter_id = :GLOBAL.chapter_id;
 /*MODIFIED BY HCL CONSULTING*/
 if capacity < box_capacity
 then
 show_error_dist('3735');
 check_package_failure;
 end if;
 end if;
 end;
 GO_ITEM('confirm_close.s_all_qc');
 else
 clear_form(no_validate);
 execute_trigger('pre-form');
 end if;
end;

ProgramUnit.Name: GEN_REPORT
ProgramUnit.ProgramUnitText:
procedure gen_report(parameter_id in VARCHAR2,
 rpt_name in VARCHAR2) is
temp_count NUMBER;
begin
 temp_count := 0;
 begin
 select count(*)
 into temp_count
 from rpt_parm
 where appl_id = 'DON' and
 user_name = :banner.user_id and
 report_name = rpt_name and
 parm_id = parameter_id;
 exception
 when OTHERS
 then
 handle_error;
 check_package_failure;
 end;
 if temp_count = 0
 then
 begin
 insert into rpt_parm
 (appl_id,user_name,report_name,parm_id,
 parm_date,submit_date,report_status)
 values
 ('DON',:banner.user_id,rpt_name,
 parameter_id,sysdate,sysdate,'E');
 exception
 when OTHERS
 then
 handle_error;
 check_package_failure;
 end;
 else
 begin
 delete from rpt_parm_select
 where appl_id = 'DON' and
 user_name = :banner.user_id and
 report_name = rpt_name and
 parm_id = parameter_id;
 exception
 when OTHERS
 then
 handle_error;
 check_package_failure;
 end;
 end if;
 begin
 insert into rpt_parm_select
 (appl_id, user_name, report_name, parm_id,
 parm_no, parm_select, parm_code)
 values
 ('DON',:banner.user_id,rpt_name,
 parameter_id, 1, :GLOBAL.chapter_id, 'CHP');
 exception
 when OTHERS
 then
 handle_error;
 check_package_failure;
 end;
 begin
 insert into rpt_parm_select
 (appl_id, user_name, report_name, parm_id,
 parm_no, parm_select, parm_code)
 values
 ('DON',:banner.user_id,rpt_name,
 parameter_id, 2, :ctrl_blk_1.box_id, 'BXID');
 exception
 when OTHERS
 then
 handle_error;
 check_package_failure;
 end;
 commit;
 host ('nohup repgen.sh -a'||'SERV '||
 '-t'||'PC '||
 '-r'||rpt_name||' '||
 '-p'||parameter_id||' '||
 '-u'||:banner.user_id||' '||
 '-q'||'hplaser3si'||' '||
 '-f'||'COMPRESSED '||
 '-h'||' -l '||
 '-c'||:GLOBAL.chapter_id||' &');
end;

select distinct bx.box_id, substr(ord.order_no,1,10) , ord.order_class, substr(to_char (ord.est_arrival_time,'MM-DD-YY HH24:MI'),1,14) , cons.name from boxes bx, pick_slips ps, pick_slip_products psp, consignee cons, chapters chp, orders ord where bx.box_status = 'OP' and bx.box_id = psp.box_id and psp.pick_slip_id=ps.pick_slip_id and ps.order_no = ord.order_no and ord.order_status not in ('CL','CA','SY','HO','PE') and ord.consignee_id = cons.consignee_id and ord.insert_date > sysdate - (nvl(chp.order_min_lifetime,0)/24+5) 
and bx.chapter_id = :g_chapter_id and bx.warehouse_id = :global.warehouse and ord.chapter_id = :g_chapter_id and cons.chapter_id = :g_chapter_id and /*modified by hcl consulting*/ ps.chapter_id = :g_chapter_id and psp.chapter_id = :g_chapter_id and chp.chapter_id = :g_chapter_id and /*modified by hcl consulting*/ sysdate between cons.eff_date and nvl(cons.term_date, sysdate+1) order by 3, 4, 5, 2, 1
